_meta.title: מדריך נורות אזהרה לדוגמה: משמעות הנורה והפעולה הנדרשת
_meta.title_en: Example warning-light rulebook for the Aldente Cars Atlantis demo fleet: what the light means and what to do
_meta.source: Synthetic example written for this repository; every entry is invented.
_meta.note: The synthetic example rulebook stands in for a fleet's own rulebook layer. It is shown first in the reply, verbatim and attributed. Hebrew text is the display text. recovery_action is the rulebook's disposition; the carmind assessment is shown underneath it, not over it.

disposition_vocab.תיאום מוסך: book a visit at the dealer (dispatch action dealer_appointment)

_meta.color_convention: כתום = amber (caution), אדום = red (stop/urgent), מהבהב = flashing (elevated). Where amber and red call for different actions, the entry says so in its recovery text; the brake-fluid entry also carries color_variants.

procedures.recovery_action_he: אם הרכב מתנהג אחרת מהרגיל - גרר. אם לא - תיאום מוסך.

procedures.explanation_he: תקלה אפשרית במערכת הבלמים או מפלס נוזל בלמים נמוך.
